content.comment_body: I am working with a customer on a septic system using a [product_name] controller. I have a new unit, but I do not have the required software on my PC to copy and transfer the configuration from the old controller. I need the installation media or a USB stick with [product_name] programming software to install it on my PC.
You will need to purchase the software from a distributor of your choice. The article number for the current [product_name] programming software is [article_no].

analysis.insight_summary: The user cannot access the necessary programming software for a [product_name] controller because they lack the installation media. This is hindering their ability to transfer configuration data between devices, illustrating the challenges field users face when obtaining essential software.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects a straightforward way to obtain and install [product_name] programming software, enabling file transfer between [product_name] hardware units.
